sources.label: Official Lacoste GB women's size guide (body measurements, product-page modal)

audit: Lacoste's old /gb/size-guide URL 404s; the body chart is now in each product's Size guide modal (Body Measurements tab, women's tops figure). Lacoste publishes letter sizes, each with FR/EU and UK sizes ('S - 34-36 - 6-8') and cm ranges for bust, waist and low hip; stored as published. No US published, so removed. Old entry had single EU-numbered rows with values matching no published chart (e.g. old EU 36/UK 8 bust 84 vs official S 82-86; old UK 16 bust 100 vs official L 98-102) and no XL (UK 18-20).
